title: Complete Asymptotic Expansion of the Additive Mertens Sum $S_k(x)$
summary: Let $p_1, \dotsc, p_k$ be primes not exceeding $x$ ($k \geqslant 2$), and define the additive Mertens sum \[ S_k(x) = \sum_{p_1 \leqslant x} \cdots \sum_{p_k \leqslant x} \frac{1}{p_1 + \dotsm + p_k}. \] In contrast to Tenenbaum's generalized (multiplicative) Mertens sum, whose leading term has order $(\log \log x)^k$, the sum $S_k(x)$ has leading term of order $x^{k-1}/\log^k x$. We establish the complete asymptotic expansion \[ S_k(x) = \frac{x^{k-1}}{\log^k x} \sum_{n=0}^{N} \frac{E_{k,n}}{\log^n x} + O_{k,N}\left(\frac{x^{k-1}}{\log^{k+N+1} x}\right) \quad (\forall\, N \geqslant 0), \]…
